text: Common Sense Immigration Reform — The New American Dream America was built by people who came here and got to work. A lean, clean, compassionate immigration process gets good people integrated and building — because messy systems don’t just waste money, they fuel corruption and cruelty.

Defending Privacy and Digital Freedom I protect personal data as private property. We will ban exploitative surveillance from corporations and the government, require informed consent, and restore digital autonomy. Your private life belongs to you both online and off.

Ecosystem Restoration Healthy ecosystems are the foundation of healthy communities. Drawing on years of direct climate research and ecosystem management work, Natalie will champion restoration of Idaho’s watersheds, forests, and grasslands — because when the land thrives, so do the people who depend on it.

Education That Inspires and Equips A garden for every school. I believe in schools that teach students to do, not just memorize. Bring back trades, arts, civics, financial literacy, media literacy, and real life skills that prepare students to thrive in the real world. If you want to know what we should be teaching our children, imagine some strange event that removed everyone over 25, what would our children need to know to have the best future?

Empowering the Vulnerable, Restoring Dignity and Independence I stand beside those who’ve been knocked down by circumstance. We will combine compassion with opportunity, Housing First, job training, rehabilitation, and mental health support. Every person deserves a fair chance to rise and a community that helps them stand.

Freedom from Perpetual Debt, Building an Ownership Society I refuse to accept a system that traps Americans in lifetime servitude to interest and perpetual rents. We will fight predatory lending, reform medical and student debt, and reward savings and asset ownership breaking free of perpetual monthly payments just to exist. Freedom means owning your life, not renting it from the corporations.

Full Data Privacy & End of Mass Surveillance Your data is your property — full stop. We will end mass surveillance by corporations and government agencies, establish comprehensive data privacy rights, require explicit consent for data collection, and hold violators accountable. A free people cannot be a surveilled people.

Healthy Food, Healthy Land, Healthy People I protect the soil, water, and families that feed America. We will clean toxins from food and water, strengthen organic and regenerative farming, and safeguard rural health. When we care for the land, it will care for us and our children will inherit abundance, not scarcity.

Home-ownership and Homesteading — Rebuilding the American Dream I fight for the right of every family to own their land, their home, and their peace of mind. We will curb corporate landlords, restore affordability, and revive small-town pathways to ownership and homesteading. When families and communities plant roots in their own soil, communities flourish and the American Dream lives again.
